review_scope: independent read-only source review plus bounded memory-sink/AST offline test; no Docker calls executed by reviewer
authorized_surface: 4 fresh fixture-owned no-mount containers only; output files in newly created explicit directory
no_existing_state_touched: no pool or mounted workspace path
no systemd or existing service operations
container_security: no HostConfig Binds/Tmpfs, no image declared Volumes, Mounts must be empty before start
none log driver and empty daemon log path
cleanup: lost-create response resolves only exact random name+fixture labels+image
after full ID known all lookup/removal binds it, exact name and labels
only identified owned fixture may be cancelled; rm requires stopped/PID0 and production RemoveOwned confirms none driver
cleanup failure persists exact plan and prevents passed report
assertions: pre-start attach acknowledgement hook before daemon StartedAt
exact early stdout out-NUL and stderr err-0xff
flood cumulative 512KiB raw-payload/64KiB preview, both streams, policy kill observed then EOF/complete, not valid verification
normal cancel requires Interrupted=true and no output-policy termination flag
detach returns ErrCaptureGap/runner_shutdown, incomplete/dropped unknown and still-running same container; observes same original natural exit without new start or attach
retained stream bytes and SHA256 persisted for offline recomputation
limits: custom memory sink counts raw payload; it does not validate runner framing or spool disk durability/quota
finite Python programs are fixture workloads; this review does not prove execution until actual raw is available
does not exercise Docker.Start profile/volume admission nor Engine SIGTERM/SQLite recovery
